headline: EVALUATE ROW("cohort_rows",COUNTROWS(fact_requests),"primary_requests",[Primary Requests],"closed_requests",[Reported Closed Requests],"open_backlog",[Reported Open Backlog],"snapshot_closure_share",[Snapshot Closure Share],"duration_eligible_closed",[Duration Eligible Closed],"median_closure_days",[Median Closure Days],"p90_closure_days",[P90 Closure Days],"mean_closure_days",[Mean Closure Days],"deadline_eligible_closed",[Deadline Eligible Closed],"closed_by_deadline",[Closed By Recorded Deadline],"closed_by_recorded_deadline_share",[Closed By Recorded Deadline Share],"open_past_recorded_deadline",[Reported Open Past Deadline],"business_duplicates",[Duplicate Marked Intake],"flag_conflicts",[Flag Conflicts In Primary],"ambiguous_timestamps",[Ambiguous Timestamps],"missing_geography_all_intake",[Missing Geography All Intake])
signal_filter: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE(ROW("requests",[Primary Requests],"open_backlog",[Reported Open Backlog],"median_days",[Median Closure Days],"p90_days",[P90 Closure Days]),TREATAS({"TPW - Traffic Signal - Maintenance"},dim_service[service_description]))
service_percentiles: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(dim_service[service_description],"requests",[Primary Requests],"duration_n",[Duration Eligible Closed],"median_days",[Median Closure Days],"p90_days",[P90 Closure Days]) ORDER BY dim_service[service_description]
closure_month_role: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(dim_date[year_month],"cohort_closures",[Cohort Closures By Closure Month]) ORDER BY dim_date[year_month]
